topic: Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber: Google's New Model Family Compared

key_points: Official Google announcement of three new Flash models on July 21, 2026
3.6 Flash: 17% fewer output tokens than 3.5 Flash, $1.50/1M input, $7.50/1M output
3.6 Flash benchmarks: DeepSWE 49% (vs 37%), MLE Bench 63.9% (vs 49.7%), OSWorld-Verified 83.0% (vs 78.4%), GDPval-AA v2 1421 (vs 1349)
3.5 Flash-Lite: 350 output tokens/s, $0.30/1M input, $2.50/1M output
3.5 Flash-Lite outperforms 3 Flash on SWE-Bench Pro (54.2% vs 49.6%) and OSWorld-Verified (74.0% vs 65.1%)
3.5 Flash Cyber: fine-tuned for cybersecurity, exclusive to CodeMender for governments/trusted partners
Gemini 3.5 Pro testing with partners, Gemini 4 pre-training started
Knowledge cutoff advanced from January 2025 to March 2026
Enhanced Frontier Safety safeguards for CBRN and cyber offense
3.6 Flash priced lower than 3.5 Flash ($7.50 vs $9/1M output tokens)
3.6 Flash delivers higher precision with fewer unwanted code edits and reduced execution loops
3.5 Flash-Lite offers significantly better quality than 3.1 Flash-Lite from March 2026
3.5 Flash-Lite available in Gemini app and rolling out to Google Search
3.6 Flash available in Gemini app, Google Antigravity, AI Studio, Android Studio
Computer use is now a built-in client-side tool via Gemini API and Gemini Enterprise
3.5 Flash Cyber access initially for governments and trusted partners as limited-access pilot
3.6 Flash ranks #21/187 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (score: 50)
Speed: #1/187 at 303.6 output tokens per second
